title: Practice 8: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я потянул за ___ (кое-какая ниточка, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **ниточка → ниточки** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural ниточки. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -и.  **кое-какой → кое-какие** (acc. pl., agreeing with ниточки). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. ниточка · ниточки · ниточке · ниточку · ниточкой · ниточке; pl. ниточки · ниточек · ниточкам · ниточки · ниточками · ниточках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**свет → свет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. свет · света · свету · свет · светом · свете; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Цемент схватится за ___ (пара, acc. sg.) часов.
exercises.prompt: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
exercises.why: **пара → пару** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. пара · пары · паре · пару · парой · паре; pl. пары · пар · парам · пары · парами · парах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он заранее знал, что Берлиоз попадет под ___ (трамвай, acc. sg.)!
exercises.why: **трамвай → трамвай** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -й. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. трамвай · трамвая · трамваю · трамвай · трамваем · трамвае; pl. трамваи · трамваев · трамваям · трамваи · трамваями · трамваях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: PETA обвинила его за ___ (сожжение, acc. sg.) мыши.
exercises.prompt: PETA accused him of setting his mouse on fire.
exercises.why: **сожжение → сожжение** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). Declension: sg. сожжение · сожжения · сожжению · сожжение · сожжением · сожжении; pl. сожжения · сожжений · сожжениям · сожжения · сожжениями · сожжениях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. exercises.q: Несмотря на позицию партии, она проголосовала за ___ (господин, acc. sg.) Нисиоку.
exercises.prompt: She voted for Mr Nishioka irrespective of party lines.
exercises.why: **господин → господина** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). exercises.q: Торжества длились несколько дней — торжества под ___ (разрыв, acc. pl.) шрапнели!

exercises.q: Том никогда не выезжал за ___ (предел, acc. pl.) Миннесоты.
